{{Quote|We'll never survive these odds. And if we vanish way out here, the Alliance will never know what happened to us. Let's bug out and head to the surface. It's our only chance.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Star Wars 1" />}}
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] undertook a '''mission''' approximately [[0 ABY/Legends|two months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dominus III]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to scout it out as a potential Rebel base. Upon arrival, pilots [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] were almost immediately ambushed by an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], which dispatched a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] to deal with the Rebels. Antilles ordered the group to the planet's surface, where Organa was shot down, taking a TIE with her in the process. She managed to climb out and kill the [[Unidentified TIE/IN Interceptor pilot|pilot of the downed TIE]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] then sent out [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] to search for the Rebels, forcing them to make a hasty escape through a polar storm.
